leads.name: Drago near Betancuria (iNaturalist cluster)
leads.reason: No photo or exact pin in reach as a verified tree. Four iNaturalist observations (e.g. 405457683, 2026-10-03, accuracy 4 m, marked casual i.e. planted/cultivated, photo CC BY-NC so not usable) put a dragon tree at FV-30 in Betancuria. No age, girth or catalogue source found; ULPGC text says Fuerteventura dragons are imported from Gran Canaria, Tenerife and La Palma (one grown from seed brought in 1889, location not seen). Alive in 2026. Needs an age/size source and an open-licence photo.
